hooks.command: git fetch -q --prune origin 2>/dev/null; git pull --no-rebase --no-edit --autostash -q origin $(git branch --show-current) 2>/dev/null; for b in $(git branch -r --format='%(refname:short)' | grep -vx origin | grep -v HEAD); do git merge -q --no-edit $b 2>/dev/null || git merge --abort 2>/dev/null; done; true
